name: Abe no Yasutsugu
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Genbu of Earth for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Seimei's son (deceased)
Occupation: Onmyouji of the Abe discipline
Innate Element: Earth
Weapon(s): Necklace (casts spells with yang-enhanced gem), shikigami (often take the shape of birds)
Hobbies: Being lost in thought
Favorite Scent: Kikka
Favorite Color: Usukou (dull orange)
Favorite Flower(s): Golden lace (autumn) / Japanese silverleaf (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
